name: Affliction
note: Three degrees, Cumulative, Progressive, Extra Condition, Limited Degree and end-of-turn recovery work; Deaf, Transformed and other minor conditions do little and durations are ignored.

name: Alternate Form
note: Alternate forms are not switched in a fight.

name: Blast
note: Fights as Damage at range (DCA 89).

name: Burrowing
note: Burrowing is not counted as movement and no one goes underground.

name: Communication
note: Communication has no effect on a fight.

name: Comprehend
note: Languages and comprehension do not matter in a fight.

name: Concealment
note: Visual concealment gives -2 or -5 to attacks against the holder; other senses and non-visual concealment are ignored.

name: Create
note: Created objects and barriers are not simulated.

name: Damage
note: Toughness check at 15 + rank with cumulative bruises, dazed, staggered and incapacitated; Strength gives built-in close Damage.

name: Dazzle
note: Fought as an Affliction (impaired, disabled, unaware) but the sense it blocks is not tracked, except that an Immunity to a sense (sight or hearing) or to dazzle effects stops it.

name: Deflect
note: Taking the Defend action to deflect protects the user and every ally in long range until its next turn; the user rolls d20 (10 or less counts 11) plus its rank against the attacker, -2 at medium range and -5 at long range, and the attacker beats the better of that and the flat defense. A rank-for-defense Defend rolls the rank in place of its own Dodge or Parry. Area, perception and non-Dodge, non-Parry attacks are never deflected. Reflect and Redirect (the Deflect extras) send a beaten attack back; the AI deflects when its own attack is worth less than the harm to its allies, or when Bodyguard or Hold the Line asks. Extended Range and descriptor effects (such as 'resistance to psionic') are not read.

name: Duplication
note: Duplicates are not created.

name: Element Control
note: Control effects (Move Object style) are not simulated.

name: Elongation
note: Stretches the fighter's close reach by the distance of its rank (rank 1 is 60 ft), counted in whole squares at the scale of the fight; the help it gives to grabbing is not applied.

name: Energy Absorption
note: Absorbing energy attacks into Enhanced Traits is not simulated.

name: Energy Aura
note: Fights as Damage that is used like a normal attack; its automatic Reaction against attackers is not simulated.

name: Energy Control
note: Fights as Damage at range; the other uses of an energy power are not simulated.

name: Enhanced Trait
note: Abilities, defenses and skills are added to the derived numbers; Enhanced Advantage is not.

name: Environment
note: Environmental changes such as darkness or heat are not simulated.

name: Extra Limbs
note: Extra limbs (holding while attacking) are not modelled.

name: Feature
note: A feature is descriptive only.

name: Flight
note: Sets how far the fighter moves each turn and the log wording; nothing else about flying (height, ground effects) is modelled.

name: Force Field
note: Counts as sustained Protection with Impervious; Nullify can switch it off.

name: Growth
note: Strength, Stamina, Dodge, Parry, Intimidation and Stealth change; extra reach and size effects do not.

name: Healing
note: A DC 10 check by touch as a standard action: each degree heals one damage condition (staggered, dazed, bruises), worst first, and a failed check cannot be tried again on that subject. The AI weighs a heal against its best attack in expected degrees. Stabilizing, the extras and the other uses are not simulated.

name: Illusion
note: Illusions are not simulated.

name: Immortality
note: Returning after incapacitation is not simulated.

name: Immunity
note: The detail text is read by the book's ranks (DCA 102-103): a descriptor's damage or its effects (a bare common descriptor by its ranks: 1 is the environment only, 5 damage, 10 every effect), physical or energy, all Fortitude, Will or Toughness effects, critical hits (a critical is a normal hit), interaction skills (Demoralize, Daze and feints fail), entrapment (no grab, snare or bond), fear (Fearless), emotion, sleep, fatigue, dazzle and sensory effects by sight or hearing, alteration, suffocation, life support (poison, disease, suffocation), your own powers, and Reflect and Redirect (the stopped attack goes back with the fighter's own attack check). Limited to Half Effect halves the rank. Every immunity that fires says which one and which descriptor in the log; the Battle Room card lists them. Not played: Affects Others and Ranged (lending an immunity), and the environment items (aging, hunger, thirst, need for sleep, one environment), which show on the card and stop nothing because a fight has no weather. Mind reading is not a fight action. house rule: the book names no descriptor list, so words in an attack's name and detail are read from one table (descriptors.js).

name: Insubstantial
note: Each Insubstantial power or alternate is a form, switched as a free action once a round (the AI turns insubstantial when that beats the harm coming in, solid again to attack). Fluid (1) flows out of holds and snares and cannot be grabbed; gaseous (2) is immune to physical damage but not to area attacks; energy (3) to physical damage and the energy of its own form; incorporeal (4) to physical and energy damage, except the effect named in the power's detail and effects with Affects Insubstantial, and it cannot affect the physical world without Affects Corporeal (or a sensory effect). Ranks 2 to 4 have no Strength. The form shows on the card and in the log. Not played: walls and objects (no moving through them, no ejection damage), Progressive, Precise, Reaction, Subtle, Affects Others and the Attack extra (turning a target insubstantial). house rule: the one other effect an incorporeal form is open to is read from the power's detail text.

name: Invisibility
note: Treated as visual Concealment; other senses are ignored.

name: Leaping
note: Counts as half its rank toward movement; jumping over things is not modelled.

name: Luck Control
note: Each rank buys one capability (named in the text, else the first ranks of grant, bestow, negate, force): grant an ally a re-roll, bestow a luck point (once per ally per round), negate an enemy's re-roll of an attack, or force an enemy hit or passed resistance check to be re-rolled at the worse (the target may spend a point to avoid it). Each is a reaction, once a round per controller, paid with Luck then hero points; a power whose text says 'against me' acts only on rolls aimed at its owner. Side Effect, Resistible and Ranged are not simulated.

name: Magic
note: Fights as Damage at range; the flexible casting that Magic allows is not simulated. Every Magic effect, and every power of a magic-source character, carries the magic descriptor (DCA 105), so an Immunity to magic stops it.

name: Mental Blast
note: Perception range Damage resisted by Will, with no attack roll.

name: Mimic
note: Copying traits from a target is not simulated.

name: Mind Control
note: Dazed, compelled and controlled work (a controlled fighter attacks its own side); the controller's other orders are not.

name: Mind Reading
note: Reading minds has no combat effect here.

name: Morph
note: Changing appearance has no combat effect here.

name: Move Object
note: Moving or throwing objects with a power is not simulated.

name: Movement
note: Special movement types are not counted.

name: Nullify
note: Opposed check against sustained protection only; other powers cannot be nullified. The AI values it by the gain for the allies who strike while the protection is down.

name: Power-Lifting
note: Only changes how much can be lifted.

name: Protection
note: Adds to Toughness, with Impervious and Sustained handled.

name: Quickness
note: Only speeds up routine tasks.

name: Regeneration
note: Recovers one damage condition per round using a simplified rank count; the book's recovery timings are not followed. With Affects Others it is lent to an ally by touch and counts as a heal.

name: Remote Sensing
note: Sensing from afar has no combat effect here.

name: Senses
note: Only senses that see through concealment (radar, tremor, danger sense and the like) are used.

name: Shapeshift
note: Changing form in a fight is not simulated.

name: Shrinking
note: Strength, Dodge and Parry change; Stealth and small-size effects do not.

name: Sleep
note: Fought as Fortitude Affliction (fatigued, exhausted, asleep); waking from noise or damage is not simulated.

name: Snare
note: Hindered and vulnerable, then defenseless and immobile, resisted by Dodge; escaping by Strength is not simulated.

name: Speed
note: Sets how far the fighter moves each turn; Speed is not used for chasing or running away.

name: Strike
note: Fights as Damage (DCA 117).

name: Suffocation
note: Fought as a progressive Fortitude Affliction; holding breath and the book's conditions are not followed.

name: Summon
note: Summoned allies are not created.

name: Super-Speed
note: Not counted as movement, and the Improved Initiative it grants is not applied.

name: Swimming
note: Counts as movement speed; water is not in the arena.

name: Teleport
note: Counts as movement speed; Teleport Attack and ranged placement are not simulated.

name: Transform
note: Transformations are not simulated.

name: Variable
note: Only Omni-power fighters reconfigure, into four fixed attacks sized to half the points.

name: Weaken
note: Weakens one trait read from the power's detail (Toughness, Strength, Dodge, Parry, Will, Fortitude, Fighting, Dexterity, an attack power by a word of its name, or all defenses) and returns a rank each round; the book's recovery rate differs. The AI values it by what the loss does to the team's next attacks or to the enemy's threat.

name: Accurate
note: Adds +2 to the attack bonus per step.

name: Affects Corporeal
note: An incorporeal (rank 4) attacker's effect works on corporeal targets at the extra's steps, up to its full rank; without it the effect does nothing. Applying it to Strength so a rank 1-3 form keeps some Strength is not read.

name: Affects Insubstantial
note: Against a fighter in a form that would stop the effect (physical or energy damage), rank 1 lands at half rank and rank 2 at full rank, logged. The AI counts it when it picks an attack.

name: Affects Objects
note: It lets Fortitude effects (Weaken, Healing, Affliction) work on objects with no Stamina. The only objects in a fight are cover pieces and held items, and the simulator only breaks them with Damage, which works on objects anyway; no fight would change.

name: Affects Others
note: Enhanced Trait (Dodge, Parry, Toughness, Fortitude, Will, Fighting, Dexterity, Agility, Stamina), Protection and Regeneration can be lent to one ally at a time by touch and last while the giver can keep them up; other powers cannot be given to allies in a fight.

name: Alternate Effect
note: Alternate attacks are separate attack choices, switched for free; alternate defenses and utilities are ignored.

name: Alternate Resistance
note: The attack uses the resistance recorded on the power; the cost changes are not checked.

name: Area
note: Burst, Cloud, Cylinder, Cone and Line catch whoever is inside the shape on the grid, sized by the Area rank (a 30 ft burst, a 60 ft cone, a 30 ft long line, doubled per extra rank); a Ranged area is centered on the target within long range, a Close one on the attacker. Each victim gets a Dodge for half. Shapeable is treated as a burst and Perception ignores concealment.

name: Attack
note: On a Teleport it makes a close attack (resisted by Will, or the defense the power names) that sends the target to the farthest open square within the Teleport distance; on an effect that is an attack already it changes nothing. Shrinking, Insubstantial, Morph and other personal effects given the Attack extra have no rule yet and are left out of the fight.

name: Contagious
note: A hit with a Contagious effect makes the target a carrier; at the end of its turn each fighter next to it (not the user) resists the effect normally and becomes a carrier too. An Affliction stops spreading when it wears off, a Weaken when the ranks return, Damage lasts the fight. Contact other than standing next to each other is not tracked.

name: Dimensional
note: The engine has no other dimensions to reach into.

name: Extended Range
note: Doubles the short, medium and long bands of a ranged attack for each rank, measured in feet between squares.

name: Feature
note: Descriptive only.

name: Homing
note: A missed ranged attack tries again at the start of the attacker's next turn as a free action, one try per rank and one a round; a miss that concealment caused loses the lock, and a target that is down or out of range ends it. The AI values the second chance.

name: Impervious
note: Impervious Protection ignores attacks of half its rank or less unless Penetrating.

name: Increased Duration
note: One, two or three ranks make the effect last as concentration, sustained or continuous: it is applied again on each of the user's turns with the target's normal resistance check and no attack check or critical. Concentration takes the standard action (the AI keeps it up when that beats its planned turn), sustained a free action, continuous nothing. It ends when the target is down. An Affliction can still be shaken off by the target's own recovery checks.

name: Increased Mass
note: Needs a mover that carries others (Teleport, Move Object with passengers); the engine moves no one along with a mover.

name: Increased Range
note: Changes the attack from close to ranged (or to perception) through the power's range; the bands then come from the attack's rank in feet.

name: Incurable
note: Healing and Regeneration cannot take off the bruises or the staggered condition that Incurable Damage caused (the Recover action can: it is normal recovery). Incurable Afflictions and Weaken are not tracked.

name: Indirect
note: Cover between the user and the target does not count (total cover included), and the first Indirect attack on each target is a surprise attack, so the target is vulnerable to it (a house rule: the book leaves it to the GM). The four ranks, which differ in where the effect can come from, are treated alike.

name: Innate
note: Nullify only ever takes sustained protection, and Innate protection is left alone; the log says so.

name: Insidious
note: Concerns detecting an effect after the fight.

name: Linked
note: Linked powers show as separate attacks instead of one combined action.

name: Multiattack
note: Two degrees of success add +2 to the resistance DC, three or more add +5.

name: Penetrating
note: Overcomes Impervious.

name: Precise
note: Fine control has no combat meaning.

name: Reach
note: Adds 5 ft per rank of the extra to a close attack's reach, counted in whole squares at the scale of the fight (nothing at 30 ft squares until it adds up to a square).

name: Reaction
note: A Deflect with Reaction deflects once a round without the Defend action, for the fighter and allies within short range; Energy Aura counts as a normal attack. No other reaction is simulated.

name: Reversible
note: Reversing an effect has no combat meaning.

name: Ricochet
note: A ranged attack on a target behind cover banks off the cover (or the walls of an enclosed room, which need no cover piece to bounce off): the cover does not count, even total cover, and the first such attack on a target is a surprise attack (a house rule). Bad Bounce checks each bounce, Pinball hits the cover, Recoverable brings spare bounces back. Only one bounce is used and no path is traced.

name: Secondary Effect
note: A hit with a Secondary Effect hits the target again at the end of the attacker's next turn, with the target's normal resistance check; they do not stack (a new hit only moves the second effect back a round).

name: Selective
note: Area attacks skip allies.

name: Sleep
note: Damage that would incapacitate leaves the target asleep (out of the fight, and not dying), and an Affliction's incapacitated degree becomes asleep.

name: Split
note: One attack check is compared against the target and one other foe in range, and the effect is divided between them (each at least a third of the rank) when that is worth clearly more than one big effect. A third target, for the higher ranks of Split, is not used.

name: Subtle
note: Concerns being noticed.

name: Sustained
note: Only Sustained Protection is used (and can be nullified).

name: Triggered
note: A fighter with a Triggered attack sets it as a trap on a square in front of it (a standard action); the effect goes off, with the foe's normal resistance check, when a foe of the setter crosses the square, once per rank. House rule: nobody notices or disarms a trap, and a variable trigger is not offered.

name: Variable Descriptor
note: Rank 1 switches the attack to a descriptor in a closely related group, rank 2 to one in a broad group. The AI does it when the target is immune to the attack as it stands, and the log says from what to what. house rule: the groups are the engine's own (temperature, weather, electromagnetic, sound, matter, physical blows, mental, magical, technological...); the book leaves them to the GM.

name: Activation
note: An attack with it needs a move (-1) or standard (-2) action to switch on first, once a fight: a move leaves the standard action for the attack when the target is already in range, a standard action is the whole turn; the AI activates it and the log says so, and values an unlit attack lower. Applies to attack effects; the same flaw on a healing, defense, movement or sense power does nothing in a fight.

name: Check Required
note: Before each use the fighter rolls the named skill or ability (else its attack bonus; house rule) against DC 10 + the flaw ranks: a natural 1 or no point over the DC fails and the action is spent, each point over is a rank of the effect (DCA 134). The AI weighs the chance and the ranks. Applies to attack effects; the same flaw on a healing, defense, movement or sense power does nothing in a fight.

name: Concentration
note: Conditions an attack causes with it last only while the user keeps concentrating: it spends its standard action each turn to hold a control that stops the target (otherwise it lets go), and the effect ends when the user is stunned, out or fled (DCA 135). Instant effects (damage) leave nothing to hold.

name: Diminished Range
note: Ranks 1 to 3 cut the short, medium and long range per rank of the effect to 10/25/50, 5/10/25 and 2/5/10 feet (DCA 135); range penalties, out-of-range, shooting distance and the AI all use the shrunk bands.

name: Distracting
note: After using it the user is vulnerable (defense halved) until the start of its next turn (DCA 135); the AI values it lower. Applies to attack effects; the same flaw on a healing, defense, movement or sense power does nothing in a fight.

name: Fades
note: Each use loses a rank (more for Fades taken again, MA 96), the effect stops at 0 and the log says so (DCA 135). Recovering a faded effect (rest, recharge, a hero point) happens outside the fight and is not simulated. Applies to attack effects; the same flaw on a healing, defense, movement or sense power does nothing in a fight.

name: Feedback
note: The engine has one manifestation, a Snare: when the snared fighter breaks out with Damage, the maker resists that Damage rank with the Snare rank as the bonus and is hurt on a failure (DCA 135). Create, Summon and Illusion are not simulated, so their objects cannot be damaged.

name: Grab-Based
note: The effect needs a successful grab (attack check, then the hold) first and follows at once when it succeeds; on a later turn, while the hold lasts, it is the standard action with no attack roll (DCA 135, 176). A target that slips every hold cannot be used on, and the AI values the attack with its grab.

name: Inaccurate
note: -2 to the attack check per rank (DCA 135), built into the attack bonus and named in the log.

name: Increased Action
note: An attack effect (a standard action) with it becomes a full action: the fighter must already be in range and does not move that turn, and a dazed or one-action fighter cannot use it (DCA 135). The AI will not pick one it cannot reach. Applies to attack effects; the same flaw on a healing, defense, movement or sense power does nothing in a fight.

name: Limited
note: Read for Immunity (half effect), Concealment and Limited Degree, and on attacks for a table of limits the engine knows the facts for: against machines, living things, the undead, flying or grounded or wounded or prone or helpless targets, minions, in melee or at range, while flying, while hurt, and against a descriptor (fire users). A limit that is not met blocks the use and the log says so; every other limit (darkness, daylight, sources, places) keeps the power working. house rule: met means full effect, not met means none.

name: Noticeable
note: Concerns being noticed.

name: Permanent
note: Only changes cost.

name: Quirk
note: Roleplaying only.

name: Reduced Range
note: The range drops one step per rank (perception to ranged, ranged to close) for attacks, areas and Healing (DCA 136): the attack check, the defense it faces and the distance it can be used from all follow.

name: Removable
note: A device with it cannot be disarmed in a fight (it only comes away when the owner is stunned and defenseless, which ends the fight for that fighter); Easily Removable devices and Equipment can be disarmed (disarm.js). The Grab action has no rule text for taking an item, so a grab does not take it (DCA 136, 176).

name: Resistible
note: The target makes a second resistance check with the defense the flaw names (its detail) and the better of the two counts; the odds and the AI use it too (DCA 137). A Resistible with no defense named changes nothing.

name: Sense-Dependent
note: A target that cannot use the sense (blind for sight, deaf for hearing) is immune, and any other target gets a Dodge check to look away or cover its ears (DCA 137); a sense the detail does not name is read from the power text. Opponents who deliberately block the sense for +10 (and give partial concealment) are not simulated.

name: Side Effect
note: On a failed use (a miss or a resisted effect) or every use, the effect rebounds on the user, who makes the normal resistance check and is not protected by its own immunities (DCA 137). house rule: the book leaves the side effect to the GM; the rebound of the base effect is one of its examples, so it is the only one built. Applies to attack effects; the same flaw on a healing, defense, movement or sense power does nothing in a fight.

name: Tiring
note: A level of fatigue each use (stacking with extra effort); the AI stops using it when one more would exhaust it (DCA 138). Tiring on only some ranks is not modelled. Applies to attack effects; the same flaw on a healing, defense, movement or sense power does nothing in a fight.

name: Uncontrolled
note: The AI never picks it; each turn it may go off by itself at a foe in range on a d20 of 11 or more. house rule: the book only says the GM decides when and how it works (DCA 138). Applies to attack effects; the same flaw on a healing, defense, movement or sense power does nothing in a fight.

name: Unreliable
note: A d20 each use: 10 or less and it fails with the action spent, a hero point makes it work; a detail such as "one shot" or "five uses" counts uses instead (DCA 138). The AI halves its value. Recovering spent uses by hero point is not simulated. Applies to attack effects; the same flaw on a healing, defense, movement or sense power does nothing in a fight.

name: Accurate Attack
note: Trade rank for attack bonus, up to 5 with the advantage and 2 without.

name: All-out Attack
note: Trade defense for attack bonus, up to 4 with the advantage.

name: Chokehold
note: Only makes the fighter likely to grab; the suffocation it causes is not applied.

name: Close Attack
note: Adds to the close attack bonus in derive.

name: Defensive Attack
note: Trade attack bonus for defense, up to 4 with the advantage.

name: Defensive Roll
note: Adds to Toughness in derive.

name: Evasion
note: Bonus to Dodge against area attacks, and a clean dodge on two degrees.

name: Fast Grab
note: A successful unarmed hit (the hit itself, not the damage) can turn into a grab as a free action.

name: Favored Environment
note: In the environment the Arena tab sets (or an enclosed room), a fighter whose advantage names it gets +2 on attack checks, or +2 on active defenses when it is hurt or outnumbered, chosen each round.

name: Grabbing Finesse
note: Holds are made with Dexterity instead of Strength. A fighter with it (or Improved Grab) is not made vulnerable while it holds.

name: Improved Aim
note: The aim bonus is +10 close or adjacent and +5 at range.

name: Improved Critical
note: Widens the critical threat range per rank (16-20 at four).

name: Improved Defense
note: +2 to the defense roll while taking the Defend action.

name: Improved Disarm
note: No attack penalty and no counter-disarm. The AI tries it with a lower bar for the odds.

name: Improved Grab
note: Makes the fighter likely to grab, and not vulnerable while it holds; keeping a free hand is not modelled.

name: Improved Hold
note: Held foes face a harder escape (+5 to the hold DC).

name: Improved Initiative
note: +4 to initiative per rank.

name: Improved Smash
note: No -5 on attacks against a held item.

name: Improved Trip
note: No -2 on the trip, no counter-trip, and the attacker picks the target's weaker of Athletics and Acrobatics. The AI tries it with a lower bar for the odds.

name: Improvised Weapon
note: Thrown scenery and picked-up objects are not simulated.

name: Move-by Action
note: The move is split around the attack and stays within the fighter's speed: a shooter shoots from where it stands and then steps back out of reach of a melee threat; a melee fighter steps in, strikes and steps out when the foe is dangerous (speedsters always).

name: Power Attack
note: Trade attack bonus for rank, up to 5 with the advantage and 2 without.

name: Precise Attack
note: Each rank ignores the cover or concealment penalty for one pairing of close or ranged attacks, such as Ranged, Cover.

name: Prone Fighting
note: No -5 on its own close attacks while prone, and close attackers get no +5 against it.

name: Quick Draw
note: A fighter disarmed of its weapon gets it back at the start of its next turn: a move action, or free with Quick Draw (a house reading: the book's Quick Draw is about drawing from a holster, and a dropped weapon is picked up).

name: Ranged Attack
note: Adds to the ranged attack bonus in derive.

name: Redirect
note: A fighter that tricked a foe turns that foe's missed attack on another foe next to it and in range, with a new check at the same modifier. The AI tricks only to set this up.

name: Set-up
note: A feint can be handed to one ally per rank: the target is vulnerable to their next attack instead of the feinter's. Demoralize and Daze are not handed over.

name: Takedown
note: A free attack against the next minion after taking one out; chains up to five.

name: Throwing Mastery
note: +1 damage per rank on thrown equipment, on Strength-based ranged attacks and on a Damage power whose Ranged Combat specialty is Throwing, shown in the attack's rank on the sheet and counted by the power level limit (the bonus stops where bonus plus rank would pass twice PL). Throwing harmless objects as weapons is not simulated.

name: Uncanny Dodge
note: The fighter is stunned but not vulnerable in a surprise round.

name: Weapon Bind
note: A fighter that took the Defend action and held off a close weapon attack makes a disarm attempt as a reaction. The AI takes the Defend action for it against a foe's weapon when its own attack is weak.

name: Weapon Break
note: A fighter that took the Defend action and held off a close weapon attack attacks the weapon as a reaction (Smash). The AI takes the Defend action for it against a foe's weapon when its own attack is weak.

name: Beginner's Luck
note: A hero point buys temporary skill ranks for a scene; in a fight a hero point is worth more as a re-roll, which the AI already spends.

name: Inspire
note: Once per fight, a standard action and a hero point: allies in interaction range get +1 per rank on all checks until the start of the inspirer's next turn. Used on the first round or when the side is losing.

name: Leadership
note: A standard action and a hero point remove dazed, stunned or fatigued from an ally in interaction range; used when the ally would do more than the leader (always for a Sustain team).

name: Luck
note: A separate pool of re-rolls, one a round up to its rank a fight, spent before hero points on attacks, resistance, opposed and recovery checks; not on healing, aid, stand or smash checks.

name: Seize Initiative
note: The fighter goes first, but no hero point is spent.

name: Ultimate Effort
note: A hero point makes an attack check, a Toughness, Will, Fortitude or Dodge check a roll of 20 (not a natural 20), as the advantage's parameter names; other kinds of check are not covered.

name: Assessment
note: A free action once per foe: Insight against its Deception tells whether its attack and defense bonuses are higher or lower than the fighter's, and more degrees give them exactly. The AI already works from the real numbers, so it only leans a little toward a foe it learned has the lower defense.

name: Benefit
note: A perk with no combat rule.

name: Diehard
note: In a lethal fight a dying fighter with Diehard rolls no check and stabilizes on the following round; further damage can still kill it. Without the Lethal damage option nobody is dying.

name: Eidetic Memory
note: Memory has no combat rule.

name: Equipment
note: Gear is read from the character, not from the advantage.

name: Extraordinary Effort
note: A fresh fighter pushing a power takes two ranks (two benefits of the same kind) for two levels of fatigue. Pairing two different benefits is not used.

name: Fearless
note: Immune to attacks the engine recognizes as fear effects (by wording) and to Demoralize, and never flees. An Immunity to fear gives the same.

name: Feature
note: Descriptive only.

name: Great Endurance
note: +5 on Fortitude checks against suffocation and against effects that start by fatiguing. Hazards (heat, cold, starvation) are not in a fight.

name: Instant Up
note: Stands from prone as a free action with no check.

name: Interpose
note: A guard within a move of the ally takes a hit meant for a weaker ally once per round; not against area or perception attacks.

name: Minion
note: Minions are built as separate combatants.

name: Second Chance
note: One more resistance check, taking the better, against an attack the advantage's named hazard matches (by words in its name, effect, resistance or descriptors). Falls, traps and skill checks are not in a fight.

name: Sidekick
note: Sidekicks are built as separate combatants.

name: Teamwork
note: Adds +5 to the Aid attack check (Aid is treated as the team check); other team checks are not simulated.

name: Trance
note: Has no combat rule.

name: Agile Feint
note: Feint with Acrobatics instead of Deception; the feint makes the target vulnerable to the feinter's next attack.

name: Animal Empathy
note: Out of combat skill use.

name: Artificer
note: Out of combat crafting.

name: Attractive
note: Social only.

name: Connected
note: Social only.

name: Contacts
note: Social only.

name: Daze
note: A standard action: Deception or Intimidation against the target's best of that skill, Insight or Will; a win leaves the target dazed. Not handed to allies with Set-up.

name: Fascinate
note: The advantage itself says combat and other immediate danger make it ineffective.

name: Favored Foe
note: A fighter gets +2 on the feint, Daze, Demoralize, Trick and Assessment against a foe the advantage names (matched by the words of its name, type or style). Perception and the fighter's own Insight when resisting are not modeled.

name: Hide in Plain Sight
note: Stealth is not simulated.

name: Improvised Tools
note: Out of combat skill use.

name: Inventor
note: Out of combat crafting.

name: Jack-of-all-trades
note: Untrained skill use is not simulated.

name: Languages
note: Language has no combat meaning.

name: Ritualist
note: Rituals are not simulated.

name: Skill Mastery
note: Skill checks are not simulated.

name: Startle
note: Feints with Intimidation when it is better; the target resists with Insight, Intimidation or Will.

name: Taunt
note: Lets the fighter demoralize with Deception instead of Intimidation; targets resist with Deception, Insight or Will.

name: Tracking
note: Out of combat skill use.

name: Well-informed
note: Social only.

name: Aid
note: A standard action: an attack check against DC 10; the ally gets +2 (or +5 on four or more degrees) on attacks against a foe, or to defense against it, until the end of the ally's next turn. The AI aids when its own attack is poor and an ally engaged with the foe has a better one, or the ally is staggered; Aid the Champion does it by tactic. Bonuses do not stack.

name: Aim
note: Aiming gives +5 (close) or +2 (farther), leaves the fighter vulnerable, and must be followed by the attack.

name: Attack
note: d20 against 10 + Parry or Dodge, natural 20 hits and natural 1 misses.

name: Charge
note: Move and then attack at -2, covering up to twice the speed.

name: Defend
note: Attackers face an opposed defense roll with 1-10 counting as 11-20; the AI only picks it when hurt and outnumbered.

name: Delay
note: Only minion squads delay, to make a team attack.

name: Demoralize
note: A standard action: Intimidation (or Deception with Taunt) against the target's Insight or Will check; impaired until the end of the demoralizer's next round, disabled on four or more degrees. Enemy minions in earshot are demoralized by one check. The AI uses it with a skill 5 or more above the target's resistance and a weak attack, against a crowd of three or more minions, or on a team's orders (Intimidate and Break). Fearless fighters are immune; the range is 60 ft.

name: Disarm
note: Attack at -2 (-5 ranged), then damage rank against Strength; a win removes the item's attacks for the rest of the fight, a loss with a melee weapon allows a counter-disarm. Equipment weapons and Easily Removable devices can be disarmed. The dropped item is never picked up, and an unarmed disarmer's grab is only logged.

name: Drop Prone
note: A ranged-heavy fighter in the open, with no cover, facing only ranged foes and needing no move, drops prone for the -5 against ranged attacks. No other reason to go down is modelled.

name: Escape
note: Athletics or Sleight of Hand against the hold ends a grab; the free move afterwards is not taken.

name: Grab
note: Attack check then Strength against Strength or Dodge, restrained or bound. The holder is hindered and vulnerable while it holds (not vulnerable with Improved Grab or Grabbing Finesse), and the AI is less keen to grab with other foes about; later cumulative grabs are not applied.

name: Move
note: A move action covers the distance rank of the fighter's speed in feet (30 ft at rank 0; Flight, Speed, Swimming, Teleport and half of Leaping count) as whole squares of 5, 30 or 250 ft, at least one; Hindered halves it, a full turn moves twice that, and walls and cover pieces are walked around. Terrain such as difficult ground is not modelled.

name: Ready
note: A close fighter with nothing to hit, facing brawlers that are about to walk into reach, holds an attack that fires as a foe moves in; a fighter with a power that can counter the best attack coming holds a counter. A readied action is lost if it does not happen before the fighter's next turn. Other triggers are not offered.

name: Recover
note: Once per fight, whole turn, removes the worst damage or fatigue and gives +2 to defenses.

name: Smash
note: Attack on a held or worn item at -5, then the item's Toughness check (device points / 5, equipment by material): two degrees break it, three destroy it, and its attacks are removed. The AI smashes when breaking the target's best item beats a plain attack. Worn armor and other non-attack items are not smashed.

name: Stand
note: Standing is a move action, free with a DC 20 Acrobatics check (a failure costs the move action) or with Instant Up. A prone fighter stands at the start of its turn when it wants to move or fight up close; a shooter that need not move stays down.

name: Trick
note: Deception against the foe's Deception or Insight: a win leaves the foe heedless (it feeds Redirect), a loss by more than a degree leaves the trickster vulnerable. The hazards the book names (a precipice, a junction box) are not in the fight.

name: Trip
note: Close attack against Parry at -2, then Acrobatics or Athletics against the target; a win leaves it prone, a loss gives it a counter-trip. The AI trips when a friend who fights up close is within reach of the target or the target shoots, and the odds beat 0.35. Not used on minions.

name: Crawl
note: A prone fighter is hindered, so it moves at half speed (the Prone condition); the Slither effect, which crawls at full speed, is not special-cased.

name: Command
note: Minions fight on their own turn under the same AI, and Summon is not simulated, so there are no orders to give.

name: Accurate Attack
note: Trade rank for attack bonus, 2 by default and 5 with the advantage.

name: All-out Attack
note: Trade defense for attack bonus, chosen by brawlers, tanks, beasts and minions.

name: Defensive Attack
note: Trade attack bonus for defense, chosen by duelists and supports under pressure.

name: Finishing Attack
note: A close attack on a defenseless target is rolled normally for a critical, or taken as a routine check (a sure hit, no critical) when the bonus is so low a roll would often miss. Killing intent is not used.

name: Power Attack
note: Trade attack bonus for rank, chosen when it raises the expected harm.

name: Slam Attack
note: A charging fighter uses its movement rank as Damage and, with the optional knockback rule on, throws the target back; the extra +1 for a full move and the damage the slammer takes are not applied.

name: Surprise Attack
note: Only through the Ambush option; stealth and unusual tactics do not make a target vulnerable.

name: Team Attack
note: Only minion squads combine attacks (+2 or +5 rank); heroes never team up.

name: Feint
note: Deception (or Acrobatics with Agile Feint) against Insight or Deception; on success the target is vulnerable to the feinter's next attack until the end of the feinter's next round (DCA 64).

name: Trick
note: Tricks with Deception are not simulated.

name: Demoralize
note: A standard action: Intimidation (or Deception with Taunt) against the target's Insight or Will check; impaired until the end of the demoralizer's next round, disabled on four or more degrees. Enemy minions in earshot are demoralized by one check. The AI uses it with a skill 5 or more above the target's resistance and a weak attack, against a crowd of three or more minions, or on a team's orders (Intimidate and Break). Fearless fighters are immune; the range is 60 ft.

name: Aid
note: A standard action: an attack check against DC 10; the ally gets +2 (or +5 on four or more degrees) on attacks against a foe, or to defense against it, until the end of the ally's next turn. The AI aids when its own attack is poor and an ally engaged with the foe has a better one, or the ally is staggered; Aid the Champion does it by tactic. Bonuses do not stack.

name: Normal
note: The state of no condition.

name: Asleep
note: Asleep is out of the fight until recovered; noise does not wake the sleeper.

name: Blind
note: The blind fighter's attacks take total concealment penalties; being unable to see targets is not otherwise modelled.

name: Bound
note: Defenseless, immobile and impaired (a hold that scored two degrees).

name: Compelled
note: Limited to one standard action; the controller's choice of action is not simulated.

name: Controlled
note: The controlled fighter attacks one of its own side each turn; other orders are not simulated.

name: Dazed
note: One standard action; wears off at the end of the target's next turn.

name: Dead
note: With the Lethal damage option: a dying fighter who fails a Damage check, or fails three degrees of its dying checks, dies; a minion taken out is killed. The log says who died. Without the option nobody dies.

name: Debilitated
note: Weaken that takes Strength, Dexterity, Fighting or Stamina below -5 collapses the fighter (defenseless, immobile, stunned), leaves it dazed and defenseless without close attacks, or makes it dying (-5 on its Fortitude checks). Agility, Intellect, Awareness and Presence are folded into Dodge and Will by the Weaken reader and cannot be debilitated.

name: Deaf
note: A deaf fighter is immune to Sense-Dependent (hearing) effects. The auditory concealment and the surprise attacks it allows are not simulated.

name: Defenseless
note: Defense counts as 0 and hits are critical; routine checks against defenseless targets are not used.

name: Disabled
note: -5 on checks, applied to attacks and resistance.

name: Dying
note: With the Lethal damage option: a fighter taken out by Damage is dying, checks Fortitude each round (DC 15; two degrees of success stabilize it, three degrees of failure in all kill it), and Treatment, Healing or Diehard can steady it. Without the option a fighter who would be dying is incapacitated.

name: Entranced
note: Treated as stunned; a hostile act does not break the trance.

name: Exhausted
note: Impaired and hindered; from extra effort fatigue or an Affliction.

name: Fatigued
note: Hindered; from extra effort or an Affliction.

name: Hindered
note: Movement is halved.

name: Immobile
note: Cannot move.

name: Impaired
note: -2 on checks, applied to attacks and resistance.

name: Incapacitated
note: Out of the fight.

name: Paralyzed
note: Defenseless, immobile and stunned.

name: Prone
note: Close attackers get +5 and ranged attackers -5 against it; the prone fighter has -5 on close attacks and moves at half speed. It stands up on its own turn (see Stand). Prone from an Affliction ends only when the Affliction does.

name: Restrained
note: Hindered and vulnerable, from a hold or an Affliction.

name: Staggered
note: Dazed and hindered until recovered; a second staggering result incapacitates.

name: Stunned
note: Cannot act; a hero point can end it.

name: Surprised
note: Stunned and vulnerable until the surprise round ends.

name: Transformed
note: Recognized in Affliction text but has no effect.

name: Unaware
note: Cannot act; the unaware fighter is not treated as defenseless.

name: Vulnerable
note: Active defenses are halved, rounded up.

name: Weakened
note: Weaken costs ranks that return one per round; the Weakened condition from other sources is not tracked.

name: Hero point: Improve Roll
note: A missed attack, a failed Toughness, Fortitude, Will or Dodge check, a lost opposed check (feint, trip, disarm, grab, escape, demoralize, Daze) and a recovery check are re-rolled (1-10 counts as 11-20) when the failure matters; healing, aid, stand and smash checks are not.

name: Hero point: Recover
note: Removes dazed, stunned or fatigue, or turns exhausted into fatigued, at the start of a turn or when stunned.

name: Hero point: Edit Scene
note: Changing the details of a scene is a story power; the AI has no use for it in a fight.

name: Hero point: Heroic Feat
note: Interpose is borrowed to take a hit that would knock out an ally, and Power Attack or All-out Attack for a finishing blow; other advantages are not.

name: Hero point: Inspiration
note: A hint from the GM has no combat use.

name: Hero point: Instant Counter
note: A target hit by an effect it has a power to counter (opposed descriptors, or the same for magic and mind: a table of the engine's own) can spend a hero point to counter it; both sides roll d20 + rank and a win cancels both. The AI does it when the hit would often do real harm and the counter would often win.

name: Extra effort: +1 power rank
note: A fighter pushing an attack power gains +1 rank and a level of fatigue (applied at once, not at the start of the next turn).

name: Extra effort: extra action
note: A fresh fighter with a hero point and a strong attack takes an extra standard action to finish a foe that is staggered or has two bruises.

name: Extra effort: +2 on a check
note: A +2 on the attack check, when the shot is a toss-up (a fighter that is losing, with a hero point to take the fatigue away). Other checks do not use it.

name: Extra effort: power stunt
note: A temporary Alternate Effect is not simulated; a fighter's own Alternate Effects are already free to switch.

name: Extra effort: extra resistance check
note: A fighter that fails its end-of-turn recovery check against a severe condition (stunned, incapacitated, entranced, controlled...) and is not already fatigued makes one more check for a level of fatigue.

name: Extra effort: +1 speed rank
note: A fighter whose foe is between two and four moves away doubles its move for the turn to reach it; the fatigue comes at the end of the turn.

name: Extra effort: +1 Strength rank
note: A losing unarmed fighter with a hero point adds a rank to its unarmed damage. Strength-based powers and grabs do not use it.

name: Extra effort: cancel fatigue
note: A hero point can cancel the fatigue, chosen by chance right after the effort.

name: Minions: no critical hits on non-minions
note: Minions never crit heroes.

name: Minions: routine attack checks
note: A non-minion hits a minion on a routine check when 10 does it.

name: Minions: fail any Damage check and drop
note: A failed Toughness check incapacitates a minion.

name: Minions: worst degree of other effects
note: A minion that fails any resistance check suffers the worst degree: the top condition of an Affliction, all the ranks of a Weaken.

name: Range bands
note: Short range is rank x 25 ft with no penalty, medium rank x 50 ft at -2, long rank x 100 ft at -5, and nothing beyond; Extended Range doubles each. Distance is the squares between fighters (diagonals count one) times the scale, and a close attack needs the same or an adjacent square.

name: Cover
note: Pieces made of real materials give -2 (partial) or -5 (total) to an attack when a piece stands in a square beside the target on the straight line from the attacker; total cover blocks direct targeting, and cover adds to Dodge against area effects. Pieces fill their square and are walked around. Fighters seek cover only when their team plays Take Cover, or use a piece beside them.

name: Concealment
note: -2 or -5 to attack a target with Concealment or Invisibility; the environment itself never conceals.

name: Knockback
note: An optional community rule, off unless switched on: damage rank minus mass rank sets the distance in feet (rank 0 is 30 ft), the target falls prone and flies square by square along the line from the attacker; cover pieces and the walls of an enclosed room can stop it or be smashed through.

name: Surprise round
note: The Ambush option gives a surprise round: surprised side stunned and vulnerable, ambushers act with one standard action.

name: Initiative
note: d20 plus Agility plus Improved Initiative; late joiners roll and slot into the order.

name: Recovery checks
note: Ongoing Affliction conditions are resisted at the end of each turn.

name: Critical success
note: A natural 20 on a check raises the degree by one (it can turn a one-degree failure into a success) in resistance, recovery, Toughness, Dodge, Aid, healing, Stand and Escape checks and in opposed checks (src/engine/battle/checks.js). Attack checks keep their own natural 20 rule: always a hit, and a threat.

name: Opposed checks
note: The higher result wins; a tie goes to the higher bonus, and with equal bonuses a d20 decides (1 to 10 for the acting fighter). Degrees are counted from the loser's result. Used by Feint, Trip, Disarm, Demoralize and Nullify.

name: Staggered
note: Three degrees of failure on Damage stagger the target; a second one incapacitates.

name: Critical hits
note: A critical adds +5 to the resistance DC (Increased Effect); Added Effect and Alternate Effect are not used.

name: Death and dying
note: With the Lethal damage option (Arena tab, tournaments, city war): attackers go for the kill (Damage that incapacitates also makes the target dying); further failed Damage checks make an incapacitated fighter dying and a dying one dead; the dying roll Fortitude each round, and the fight goes on until they die or steady. Off by default.

name: Ongoing effects
note: Afflictions are re-checked at the end of the target's turn.

name: Area effects
note: Everyone inside the template (friends too, unless Selective) makes a Dodge check for half; cover pieces inside it take a Toughness check. Cover only helps the Dodge; shapes follow the map tools' template geometry.

name: Perception range
note: Perception-range effects need no attack check and cannot critically hit.

name: Defense class
note: Close attacks hit 10 + Parry, ranged attacks 10 + Dodge, vulnerable halves defenses.

name: Fatigue
note: Extra effort and Afflictions cause fatigue; exhaustion at three levels incapacitates; rest and hazards are not simulated.

name: Damaging objects
note: Cover pieces are defenseless objects: a hit at DC 10 is an automatic critical, two degrees of failure on the Toughness check punch a hole and three destroy the piece. Area attacks, shooting through cover and knockback collisions roll against it too.

name: Minions: demoralized as a group
note: Enemy minions that can see and hear the demoralizer are demoralized together by one check against the highest resistance among them; a demoralized minion of a side facing Intimidate and Break flees half again as readily.

name: Fighting Withdrawal: escape
note: Under the Fighting Withdrawal tactic a fighter who starts a turn on its own edge and is not held gets away; the team wins by getting half its fighters out, or by holding out for a set number of rounds. Escape is only a tactic: other fights never let anyone leave.

name: Close Combat
note: The attack bonus of every close attack, per specialty.

name: Ranged Combat
note: The attack bonus of every ranged attack, per specialty.

name: Acrobatics
note: Standing up from prone (DC 20) and the feint check with Agile Feint.

name: Athletics
note: Grab and escape checks.

name: Deception
note: Feint, Daze and (with Taunt) Demoralize checks.

name: Insight
note: Resisting a feint.

name: Intimidation
note: Demoralize and Daze checks.

name: Sleight of Hand
note: Escaping a grab (the better of this and Athletics).

name: Stealth
note: Stealth is not simulated; an ambush is a battle option, not a check.

name: Treatment
note: First aid and treating poison are not used; only Healing powers restore fighters.

name: Expertise
note: Knowledge skills have no use in a fight.

name: Investigation
note: Searching and deducing have no use in a fight.

name: Perception
note: Noticing things is not part of the fight.

name: Persuasion
note: Talking has no use in a fight.

name: Technology
note: Building and using devices is outside the fight.

name: Vehicles
note: Vehicle combat is not simulated.

name: Communal
note: Martial Arts (3e) effect; not simulated in fights yet.

name: Extra Attacks
note: Martial Arts (3e) effect; not simulated in fights yet.

name: Ammunition
note: The firing weapon's range is not tracked: ranges come from the power's own rank.

name: Combo Element
note: Combo points and the Combo Finish are not simulated.

name: Conductor
note: Mediums that carry a touch effect are not simulated.

name: Diminishing Counter
note: A counter that fails still saps the attack: its rank is cut to the margin by which the counter lost, plus one.

name: Improved Counter
note: Each rank lets the power counter one more descriptor than the opposed pairs; the AI takes whichever one is coming (a house reading of "choose a descriptor").

name: Overwhelming Counter
note: A counter that wins sends one rank of itself per degree of the win back at the attacker, who defends and resists as normal.

name: Partial Resistance
note: A one-degree success halves the effect's ranks: the +1 version allows a second check at the halved rank to resist outright, the +2 version counts it as a degree of failure.

name: Pinball
note: With Ricochet, a Damage bounce also hurts the cover piece it bounces off. Other effects, and bouncing off walls, do nothing extra.

name: Potent
note: Adds +1 to the resistance DC per rank on Parry, Dodge, Fortitude and Will effects, without more rank (not on Toughness).

name: Proficient
note: +2 per rank on the effect's power checks: Nullify, Healing and countering. Its Alternate Effects and other power checks are not simulated.

name: Recoverable
note: With Ricochet, spare bounces bring the attack back to the user, who catches it with a Dexterity check against the attack roll; two degrees of failure and it is made against the user. A spare bounce is read as one left over after the bounce used on cover.

name: Stacking
note: Each repeat use on the same target in a round raises the resistance DC by 1 per rank, and the bonus fades a point a round. The flat-rate time options and the Stacking Alternative are not used.

name: Announcement
note: Shouting the name is free and nothing in a fight stops it (no silence or gag effect is simulated), so it changes nothing.

name: Bad Bounce
note: The flaw is read onto the attack and the per-bounce attack check DC is ready (10 against a still surface, else 10 + defense, +2 per earlier bounce), but needs the Ricochet extra, which is not simulated yet.

name: Calling
note: Needs the Summon effect, which is not simulated (summoned allies are not created), so there is no minion to call.

name: Chained
note: A chained attack works only if the power named in its detail worked (hit and was not resisted) in the user's previous turn, so the AI uses the prerequisite first (MA 95). A prerequisite that is not one of the fighter's attacks, or none named, counts as done.

name: Diluted
note: Each rank takes 1 off the effect's resistance DC, never below 10, without lowering its ranks (MA 96); the DC, the odds and Afflictions that persist all use it.

name: Dulled
note: While the condition in its detail holds (the same phrase table as Limited, read as "against ..."), the effect loses the flaw's ranks; at rank 0 the base DC stays, and Completely Dulled (-2) at rank 0 does nothing (MA 96). A condition the engine cannot read never applies.

name: Fast Return
note: A Weaken with it gets back one more rank per flaw rank at the end of each of the target's turns (MA 96). house rule: it is kept per target, not per Weaken effect, so two Weakens on one target share the better rate.

name: Gallant
note: Each use costs a hero point and cannot be made without one (MA 97). With hero points off in the battle it costs nothing (house rule). Applies to attack effects; the same flaw on a healing, defense, movement or sense power does nothing in a fight.

name: Immobile
note: The attack is used where the fighter stands, after no movement; a fighter out of range closes in first and uses it next turn, and the 2-point version also keeps the fighter still while it is used (MA 97). Applies to attack effects; the same flaw on a healing, defense, movement or sense power does nothing in a fight.

name: Inexact
note: Each target in the area needs its own attack check first (a hit still gets its Dodge check) (MA 97). house rule: an area has no attack bonus, so the fighter's attack bonus is used.

name: Momentum-Based
note: The effect works only if the fighter has moved this turn, and then with all its ranks (MA 97): in range already, the fighter first steps to an open square (the run), and a fighter with no move left cannot use it. house rule: any move counts as running at the fighter's full movement rank, since the grid does not track speed ranks (the book caps the rank at the current speed rank).

name: Nonlethal
note: The fight engine ends at incapacitated; dying and dead are not modelled, so every attack is already unable to kill.

name: Obvious
note: Only makes the effect easier to notice (Perception); noticing is not simulated.

name: Prone
note: After the effect the user makes an Agility or Acrobatics check against DC 10 + rank to stay on its feet, or falls prone; the 2-point version always does (MA 98). The prone fighter gets up through the Stand rules.

name: Push Over
note: The user is braced less against knockback (Toughness -1 per rank in the book) until its next turn (MA 98). house rule: the knockback rule here works from mass rank, so each flaw rank counts as one rank less mass.

name: Source
note: The environment (a fire, a person, a place) is not modelled, so a Source is never missing and the power keeps working.

name: Strained
note: The effect never uses extra effort (MA 98).

name: Uncertain
note: The critical miss range grows by one natural number per rank: a natural 1 and 2 with one rank (MA 98).

name: Weak Limbed
note: Needs the Extra Limbs effect, which is not simulated (extra limbs do not hold or attack).
